# tlsinfo

> TLS connection analysis: CLI + Go library. Reports handshake state, certificate chains, key pins, OCSP status, crypto hygiene. Zero-bloat: stdlib + paepcke.de/certinfo + paepcke.de/reportstyle + golang.org/x/crypto only.

Repo: https://github.com/paepckehh/tlsinfo | Docs: https://pkg.go.dev/paepcke.de/tlsinfo

## Commands

- `make test` — offline unit tests (loopback-only TLS server, no network)
- `make check` — gofmt -w -s, go vet, go fix, golangci-lint (root + cmd/)
- `make examples` — run CLI against live hosts (network)
- `go run paepcke.de/tlsinfo/cmd/tlsinfo@latest <host>` — run the CLI

## Layout

- `api.go` — public library API + generic backend (the core)
- `generic.go` — unexported helpers (consts, version table, splitAddr, addPort, dial timeout)
- `starttls.go` — STARTTLS backend: protocol table (`_starttlsProtocols`), upgrade dialer
- `cmd/tlsinfo/` — CLI main (thin wrapper, POSIX flags via stdlib `flag`)
- `docs/hero-dark.svg`, `docs/hero-light.svg` — hand-built SVG README banners, switched by `<picture>` + `prefers-color-scheme`
- `docs/demo-report.svg`, `docs/demo-alert.svg` — console captures of real CLI output (`github.com`, `expired.badssl.com`), ANSI colors mapped 1:1, embedded in the README

## API quick map

- `ReportHost` / `ReportStartTLS` — full report for a host (implicit TLS / STARTTLS)
- `PinHost` / `PinVerifyHost` — SPKI base64 key pins, trust-on-first-use
- `ReportTlsState` / `ReportConn` — report from `tls.ConnectionState` / `*tls.Conn`
- `ReportHttpRequest` — server-side variant: report your own HTTPS clients
- `ReportOcsp` — stapled OCSP status (needs the issuer certificate; the response is bound to the presented leaf and stale responses are flagged)

## Conventions

- CLI: POSIX flags (`-starttls`, `-pin`, `-verbose`, `-html`, `-no-color`, `-version`); flags must precede hosts; env vars `NO_COLOR`, `VERBOSE`, `HTML`, `PINONLY`, `STARTTLS` act as fallback defaults (empty = off); piped hosts win, empty input falls back to argv
- CLI exit codes: 0 ok, 1 host check failed, 2 usage error; version injected at build time via `-ldflags "-X main._version=<git tag>"`, with a `debug.ReadBuildInfo()` fallback for `go install` builds (shown at startup, in `-h`, and via `-version`)
- Errors embedded in returned strings: `[tlsinfo]` / `[starttls]` `[error] ...`, tagged once at the exported boundary; the CLI appends the missing newline
- Output values are passed through `Style.SaniFunc` (HTML escaping), reports are wrapped in `Style.Start`/`End`; caller `*tls.Config` is cloned, never mutated
- STARTTLS protocols: `smtp`, `imap`, `pop3`, `nntp`, `ftp`; one response line is capped at 4096 bytes
- go 1.27.2, CGO disabled, gofmt -s; `v*` tag pushes cut goreleaser releases

See AGENTS.md for repo commands, architecture, conventions and gotchas before changing code.
